title: Broomba
description: Silly little Minecraft mod that adds the ability to harvest brains from mobs, which you can put in roomba-like robots
body:
# Broomba

Silly little mod that adds robots in which you put brains. You get the brains by killing villagers.

The robot only becomes active if you give it one of these brains, without one it becomes inactive.
Active in this case means roaming around aimlessly.
They are essentially pets you can en- and disable, inspired by the brain roomba from the Fallout TV show.

## Planned Content

- Different behavior based on former owners of the brains, for example:
  - Following you if given a wolf brain
  - Hunting chickens if given a fox brain
- Customizable behavior by modifying brains, for example:
  - Tilling soil into farmland
  - "sucking" up grown crops
- Storing memories in the brain
